reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: It is good but if you dont like smell on your toner,maybe this not be the one for you. The smell does not bother me but my friends who try it said it strong. For me,it smell in the beginning but after awhile,the smell gone.
reviews.zh: 整體係唔錯嘅，但如果你唔鍾意爽膚水有味道，咁呢支未必啱你。味道就唔會困擾到我，但我啲朋友試過都話好強。我自己用嘅時候，一開始係有味道嘅，但過一陣就散咗。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I have tried at least 5 other popular toners and this one is the best so far, hands down! i repurchased it and will keep it in my nightly rotation. I really love its consistency and i feel like it moisturizes my skin and makes my skin feel and look even, soothed, brighter. i recommend this product to everyone!
reviews.zh: 我試過最少另外 5 款熱門爽膚水，呢支暫時係最好嘅，毫無懸念！我已經回購，而且會列入我每晚嘅護膚流程。我真心好鍾意佢嘅質地，覺得佢幫我保濕，令皮膚睇落同摸落都更均勻、更舒緩、更明亮。我推薦呢個產品畀所有人！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: It has a wonderful texture. It makes my skin super soft but there is a pretty strong fragrance to it that I definitely wasn't expecting. It kind of burns when you first apply it (make sure you don't have any open acne) but it is kind of refreshing first thing in the morning!
reviews.zh: 質地好好。用完皮膚超級軟，但有種幾強烈嘅香味，呢點真係我完全冇預料到。一搽上去有少少刺痛感（要確保冇開放性暗瘡），但朝早第一樣用就幾清爽！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I absolutely love this toner I have gone through many bottles of this toner so I had to buy another one. I have combination skin and I enjoy using this toner throughout the whole year. This toner is moisturizing but it is scented and smells like lavender (it is available in an unscented version).
reviews.zh: 我絕對鍾意呢支爽膚水，已經用完好多樽，所以要再買一支。我係混合性肌膚，成個年都用緊呢支爽膚水。佢有保濕效果，不過帶香味，聞落似薰衣草（亦有推出無香味版本）。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I know why people really like this toner...it really is great! I already have moisturized skin so when i use a hydrating toner most of the time i do not see a huge difference. But this toner works! It is moisturizing, soothing, and does not lead to any breakouts. I can always tell my skin looks better after using it.
reviews.zh: 我明白點解大家都咁鍾意呢支爽膚水⋯⋯真係好好用！本身皮膚已經有返咁上下水潤，所以用保濕爽膚水大多數情況下我都唔會見到太大分別。但呢支真係 work！佢保濕、舒緩，而且用完冇爆瘡。用完之後我成日都感覺到皮膚睇落好咗。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: This hydrating toner is absolutely wonderful! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and smooth after each use. The formula is gentle yet effective, providing a nice boost of hydration without being too heavy or greasy. I love how it preps my skin for the next steps in my routine, and it gives my complexion a fresh, dewy glow. After using it consistently, my skin feels more balanced and refreshed
reviews.zh: 呢支保濕爽膚水真係超讚！每次用完皮膚都感覺超級軟滑。配方溫和但有效，可以為皮膚補水，但又唔會太厚重或油笠。我好鍾意佢幫皮膚準備好迎接之後嘅護膚步驟，仲會令膚色帶有清新嘅水光感。持續用落去，皮膚感覺更加平衡同有精神。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I love this toner so much that I confidently buy the jumbo size knowing I’ll use it all up :) It’s super moisturising yet not at all heavy and absorbs into the skin nicely. It does have a faint scent but personally I like it
reviews.zh: 我太鍾意呢支爽膚水，所以好有自信咁買咗大裝，知道自己一定會用晒佢 :) 佢超級保濕但完全唔厚重，吸收到皮膚嘅效果好好。係有少少香味，但我就幾鍾意。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I just bought this toner to try as I love natural ingredients and this one has black rice. This toner is not too thick and is easily absorbed without leave a sticky feeling. It has a herbal scent which I like. I find that after using this, my skin feels more hydrated and soft!
reviews.zh: 因為鍾意天然成分所以買咗呢支爽膚水試吓，佢含有黑米。質地唔會太杰，好容易就吸收得晒，唔會有黏笠感。佢有種草本香味，我都幾鍾意。用完之後皮膚感覺更加保濕同柔軟！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
